name: Edgeville Dungeon
accessNote: Free-to-play; enter the Edgeville Dungeon via the trapdoor in the house south of Edgeville bank or the Wilderness ditch entrance. 12 hill giant spawns, the most convenient non-Wilderness spot for Mazchna's assignment. The Slayer task/Hill giants table (pageid 298054) lists Edgeville Dungeon as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
